entries.title: Move between a card's questions from the keyboard
entries.body: When a decision asks several questions, its picked count is now a stepper: the arrows beside it bring the previous or next question into view, and a click on the count goes to the next one still unanswered. From the keyboard, ⌘J and ⇧⌘J move between the questions, Enter takes the option you are on and goes on, Shift+Enter goes back, and the number keys 1 to 9 pick an option directly. After the last question, Enter lands on the card's main button, so ⌘1 or Enter sends your answers.

picture.alt: A decision card with three questions, the first one answered, and small arrows on either side of the 1 of 3 picked count in its footer.
